parameters.formDescription:
Sends one paced batch (max 100) to opted-in contacts on WhatsApp. Run it again with the same campaign name to continue; people already reached are skipped. Always run Test first.
Variables: {{first_name}} {{name}} {{phone}} and any extra CSV column, e.g. {{city}}.

values.placeholder: Hi {{first_name}}! Our Diwali menu is live …

parameters.completionTitle: ={{ $('Build Campaign Batch').first().json.live ? '🚀 Campaign batch queued' : '🧪 Test message queued' }}

parameters.completionMessage:
=OpenWA answered {{ $json.statusCode }}: {{ $json.body && ($json.body.message || $json.body.error) ? [].concat($json.body.message || $json.body.error).join('; ') : 'no details' }}

Common causes: session not connected (409), daily send-pacing cap reached, or the API key is not allowed on this session (403). Nothing was marked as sent; fix it and run again.

parameters.content:
## WhatsApp campaign sender — setup
1. Add two **string** columns to the `wa_contacts` data table: `last_campaign`, `last_sent_at`.
2. Uses the same `OpenWA API key` Header Auth credential as the upload workflow.
3. In **Send Bulk via OpenWA** replace `REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID`.
4. Activate. Form: `https://n8n.marvice.tech/form/wa-campaign-send` (n8n login).

**Safe sending:** one batch (≤100) per run, 10s+ randomized gaps, opted-in + verified contacts only. OpenWA's SEND_PACING daily cap still applies on top. New numbers: stay under ~50/day for the first week, then scale gradually.
